# copick add ctf

<span class="source-badge source-badge--core" title="Part of copick core">core</span>

*Set the CTF fits of a tilt series from a file.*

## Usage

```bash
copick add ctf [OPTIONS] PATH
```

## Description

Reads per-image defocus, astigmatism and phase shift from an AreTomo3 _CTF.txt, a CTFFIND4 output file, a Warp
tilt-series XML or a RELION tomograms.star, and stores them on the matching sections of a writable tilt series.

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `PATH` | The CTF file. |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `-c, --config` | path | — | Path to the configuration file. |
| `--run` | text | **required** | The run. |
| `--ts-type` | text | `raw` | The tilt series. |
| `--format` | choice (aretomo3 \| ctffind4 \| warp \| relion) | — | Format of PATH. Default: from its name (_CTF.txt, .txt, .xml, .star). |
| `--tomo-name` | text | — | RELION: the tomogram. Default: the run name. |
| `--section-map` | choice (auto \| index \| sorted \| angle) | `auto` | How the rows of a file map to tilt-series sections: 'auto' (the file's default), 'index' (row i is section i), 'sorted' (rows in ascending angle pair with sections in ascending nominal angle) or 'angle' (nearest nominal angle). |
| `--angle-tolerance` | float | `1.0` | Largest difference in degrees between a row's angle and the nominal angle of its section. |
| `--debug / --no-debug` | boolean flag | `False` | Enable debug logging. |

## Examples

```bash
copick add ctf TS_01_CTF.txt --run TS_01 -c config.json
```
